verdict.rationale: Parsec is a remote desktop and streaming tool. Background automations are a plausible ask for this kind of product, so the axis applies, but the evidence shows no user-configurable automations that run on their own. The Teams API 'to automate Parsec deployment' and 'API access for automation and reporting' are developer building blocks for scripting admin tasks, not a built-in autonomous automation capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
